mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO javbus_movie_sample (movie_id, sample_id, alt, src, thumbnail, created_at) VALUES
(#{movieId}, #{item.sampleId}, #{item.alt}, #{item.src}, #{item.thumbnail}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.movie_id AS movieId, s.sample_id AS sampleId, s.alt AS alt, s.src AS src, s.thumbnail AS thumbnail, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM javbus_movie_sample s JOIN javbus_movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id WHERE m.code = #{code} ORDER BY s.id ASC
